keyFindings: Triple-layered CloudTec pods deliver springy, responsive cushioning with a firmly supportive feel rather than ultra-plush comfort
Embedded Speedboard nylon plate works with CloudTec to create a dynamic, propulsive sensation that helps you 'rock forward' through each stride
Rocker shape and firm midsole provide excellent lockdown and support with minimal side-to-side movement through the midfoot and heel
Enhanced outsole tread provides improved grip in wet conditions like snow and slush compared to similar road shoes
Best for runners wanting a firmly cushioned shoe with a rocker shape and a dynamic ride; works equally well for running and walking
